verses.text: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.

segments.text: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity:

verses.text: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.

segments.text: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me;

verses.text: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.

segments.text: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes;

verses.text: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

segments.text: I have not sat with men of falsehood;

verses.text: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.

verses.text: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;

verses.text: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.text: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.

verses.text: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;

verses.text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.text: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
